meta.policy: Keep a queen Miles bed reachable from both sides; nothing may collide or stop a door short; the main walkway from the hall door past the foot of the bed must stay at least 20 inches; bed sides at least 15 inches (today's north side is about 16.75); everything else is a trade-off measured against today. Priorities in order: main walkway, bed-side room, storage, fewest changes, cost.
